summary: The first programme successor source uses explicit organization binding v4/schema2 and a closed stable enrollment/v2 population. Current native issue, dependency and protected owning-plan observations no longer inherit pilot open-state, timestamp or empty-edge assumptions. Read-only inspection exposes complete enrolled/unselected memberships and bounded native PR associations, heads, literal changed-file scope, reviews and checks, including non-enrolled work. Source, planning, membership and head barriers preserve incomplete or changed coverage as unknown. The scoped product binding keeps its existing inspection contract. Successor writers refuse before IO; no Status or native migration authority is added. The exposed typed integrator seam separates source and activation prerequisites, existing-work continuation and new dispatch, canonical scope conflicts, explicit denial and missing evidence. Native closing references do not establish a complete owning-issue Current deliverable join. The ordinary CLI still lacks trusted production current-deliverable/slice/action, prerequisite, intake, capacity and original-reservation suppliers, so this is useful source preparation with .8 open, not accepted planning adoption. Publication/installed identity, Observation writer, admitted migration, actual UI and real-use consumer cutover remain separate gates. The maintained coherence workflow includes PR-body edited events: finalize review prose before initial PR admission and avoid checkpoint-only body updates while preserving required exact-head corrections; no measured savings are asserted.
title: Programme inspection source observes native work while operational suppliers remain separate
